businessMeaning: Replace legacy server-error, unauthorized, access-denied and exception-history pages with a central tenant-safe HRIS operations view that supports read, redacted detail, receipt inspection and allowlisted owner deep links while leaving every recovery command with its domain owner.

provenExisting: PEP-SYS-040 GET /api/platform/v1/admin/hris/command-receipts/{receiptId} is already implemented in HrisCommandReceiptController with v48 command-receipt capability, originating-command predicate, opaque denial and targeted tests.
Generic product telemetry and WorkplaceExceptionConsole provide reusable operational patterns but are not the SYS-002 HRIS exception projection.
The shared IA node also references SYS-006 automation actions, which are outside this slice.
missingWork: Consume owner-produced SYS-EVT-009 envelopes into a monotonic tenant-scoped operational exception projection.
Implement PEP-SYS-037 list and PEP-SYS-038 redacted detail.
Implement IAQ-059 and the read/deep-link-only settings operations workspace.
Bind the existing PEP-SYS-040 receipt reader without creating a second receipt controller or store.
reuseOnly: generic telemetry correlation and problem response conventions
noTouchOrRecount: Do not duplicate or count PEP-SYS-040 as new SYS-002 implementation.
Do not move or proxy recovery commands into the central operations view.
Do not implement or count SYS-006 automation commands exposed by the shared IA node.
Do not treat WorkplaceExceptionConsole or generic telemetry as completed SYS-002 business evidence.
Do not mutate Platform V330, product authorization v48 or historical registers.

experienceContract.primaryUser: HRIS configuration author or authorized operational exception reader
experienceContract.operationalQuestion: Which HRIS operational exceptions affect authorized users or processes, what is their current owner state, and where should investigation continue?
experienceContract.primaryAction: Inspect a redacted exception and open the allowlisted owning-domain deep link or existing command receipt.
experienceContract.scopeRule: Customer impact and owner state precede infrastructure detail; central recovery buttons are forbidden.

migration.predecessor: V330 is consumed by R7-C1 controlled-export topology and is immutable.

rollout.receiptGateDecision: The fresh token must preserve the existing endpoint and may only separate its shared false gate if central operations requires independent default-off admission.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Valid SYS-EVT-009 envelopes materialize one tenant-scoped exception projection with monotonic owner revision.
Duplicate digest is idempotent and out-of-order or conflicting owner revision does not overwrite newer state.
PEP-SYS-037 provides stable scoped ordering and cursor binding; PEP-SYS-038 returns exact redacted detail or opaque denial.
Owner route keys and deep-link parameters are allowlisted; arbitrary URLs or recovery commands are never returned.
PEP-SYS-040 is reused byte-for-behavior with originating-command scope and is not duplicated.
Wrong tenant, package scope, purpose, field decision, revision or capability fails closed without exception existence leakage.
The central view is read and deep-link only; all recovery mutations remain in the owning domain.
IAQ-059 excludes SYS-006 automation actions and reports unavailable, partial and stale owner projections explicitly.
Loading, empty, unavailable, partial, complete, permission and stale states preserve scope and selection without a blank canvas.
1440, 1280, 390, 320 and 200-percent zoom plus light, dark, high contrast, reduced motion and keyboard navigation pass.
Feature OFF or unenrolled tenant mounts no exception query runtime and processes no owner event into an exposed projection.
Changed-path evidence proves PEP-SYS-040, SYS-006, owner recovery commands, V330, v48 and historical registers were not modified or recounted.

backendTargets: existing shared receipt feature-gate and security tests
frontendTargets: one read-to-owner-deep-link responsive and accessibility journey after central Auth integration
databaseTargets: V331 clean install and V330-to-V331 real PostgreSQL upgrade

required: backend and frontend module branch SHAs
twelve acceptance results with test or source evidence
V331 clean and V330-to-V331 upgrade evidence
event monotonicity, duplicate and out-of-order evidence
tenant, package, redaction and deep-link negative evidence
